Petra Hartigan taps the table twice, then speaks softly, waiting for her family to lean in.

"Freya, the children. Listen close." She pauses, looking at each of them in turn. "Her own mother used to say, the ledger never sleeps, only the people keeping it. We've got 360 sim owed for upkeep today, and 120 for head tax. That's 480 before we put a bite in our mouths or earn a single sim working."

She stands, adjusting her collar. "I'm heading to the forest. Timber's what I know, and it's what pays." She glances at Freya - government clerk, steady income, but never quite enough. "You know where to find me if there's trouble."

The forest calls. The morning light is already climbing, and Petra Hartigan has never been one to let good daylight go to waste.

*(taps table twice)*

"Back when I've earned us our keep."  Petra Hartigan walks to Kasukabe Forest. She has 4998 sim remaining. She arrives at Kasukabe Forest. The morning light filters through the canopy. Seven ticks pass in the walking. She is at Kasukabe Forest now. No one else is here. The trees stand waiting. She looks up at the ones marked for felling, spots the blight on the third oak before it would show to anyone else. A week early, as always. She notes it, will mention it to... someone. If anyone asks.

The work is here. The forest gives, but only to those who know how to ask properly. Her hands find the familiar grip of the axe handle before she even thinks. This is what she was born to do. Fell timber. Earn the day's keep. Balance the ledger before it has to be asked for.

She is at Kasukabe Forest. The work can begin.
